title: PortfolioActivitySnapshot v1
description: Interface E (SPEC.md §4 E): investment-reviews' complete history of parsed trades and corporate actions, as one generation. Trades and corporate actions only: no positions, cash, decisions or calculated results. A consumer validates the whole document and reconciles it in one transaction; a missing, invalid or stale snapshot is never an empty history.

snapshotId.description: The SHA-256, in lower-case hex, of the canonical JSON of {securities, activities, tombstones} (SPEC.md §4 E). The same history gives the same id whenever it is generated.

asOf.description: The date, Europe/London, of the notes the history was built from: complete as recorded by then.

accountCategories.description: The accounts the history covers, every one in full.

historyFrom.description: The earliest tradeDate in activities; null when there are none.

completeness.description: Always complete: a producer that cannot read a source or parse a note publishes nothing rather than a partial history.

securities.description: Every security an activity or conversion names, once each.

activities.description: Every event in the history, ordered by tradeDate, accountKey, securityKey, eventType and eventId.

tombstones.description: Every event an earlier generation published that the history no longer has. Kept in every later generation, so a consumer that missed one still learns of the removal.

utcTimestamp.description: UTC, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix.

nonNegativeDecimal.description: A decimal of zero or more.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Prices quoted in pence are given in pounds.

accountKey.description: The account category. The broker is not recorded.

securityKey.description: The producer's key for a security: its Yahoo-style ticker after its own renames, e.g. EXA.L.

yahooSymbol.description: The symbol the producer prices it under.

name.description: The name on the security's notes, or null where they give none.

currency.description: The currency it trades in, or null where the notes do not say.

eventId.description: The SHA-256, in lower-case hex, of accountKey|securityKey|tradeDate|eventType|ordinal (SPEC.md §4 E). Stable when notes are re-parsed, reordered or moved between tag directories.

revision.description: 1 when first published; one more each time the event's content changes.

eventType.description: buy and sell as executed or, for a merger, as the cash it paid (derivation merger_as_sale); conversion for a split, consolidation, conversion or share grant; transfer_out and transfer_in for units, cost or both moved between holdings, such as a bed-and-ISA or the cost a demerger apportions.

quantity.description: Units, greater than zero for a buy or sell. For a conversion, the first term of its ratio: the units held are multiplied by conversion.newQuantity / quantity, and a quantity of 0 is a share grant of conversion.newQuantity units. For a transfer, the units moved, which may be 0 when only cost moves.

unitPrice.description: Per unit, in currency; null for a conversion.

currency.description: The currency of unitPrice; null for a conversion.

gbpConsideration.description: The total in GBP as the producer records it: for a broker note, the note's total, which may include its charges (charges are not separated in v1); for a transfer, the cost moved; null for a conversion.

conversion.description: What a conversion turned the units into; null for every other event.

newQuantity.description: The second term of the ratio; for a share grant, the units granted.

newSecurityKey.description: The security it became, or null when unchanged.

newCurrency.description: The currency it trades in after, or null when unchanged.

derivation.description: Where the event comes from: a broker's contract note, a broker's corporate-action note, the operator's manual entry, a merger recorded as a sale for cash, or a bed-and-ISA the producer inferred from a same-day sale and purchase.

sourceRef.description: Provenance, not identity: the note's path relative to the producer's notes root, or null for an event no single note records.

removedAt.description: The generatedAt of the first generation without it.
